items.title: Universal injectivity of the map into the adic completion for a finite flat module, under a condition on the associated primes of the fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a flatness-flavoured sufficient condition for the map from a finite module into its $I$-adic completion to be universally injective over the base: the associated primes of the fibres must avoid the ideal after extending to $S$ (statement lines 2102-2119). The proof reduces it to the general criterion by invoking the Bourbaki results that control associated primes of tensor products through those of the fibres. The reduction of the hypothesis to the fibrewise condition is the substance, so the claim is H2.
